world.title: Existing drug helps mice clear blood through meningeal lymphatic system after stroke
world.description: A drug already used to improve blood circulation and prevent certain types of stroke could have an unexpected new role in promoting recovery after bleeding in the brain. In a study published in Stroke, a team led by researchers at National Taiwan University found that cilostazol helped mice recover from intracerebral hemorrhage (ICH) by boosting the brain's natural drainage system.
